nodes.description: Lets the message out on pass when the condition is true, on reject otherwise.

fields.help: Uses payload fields, e.g. metrics.temp > 50 && status == "online".
fields.label: Condition

nodes.label: Filter

nodes.description: Routes the message by rules checked in order. Each rule has its own output, in rule order, followed by otherwise.

fields.help: List of {name, expression}. Rule outputs come first, then otherwise.
fields.label: Rules

nodes.label: Switch

nodes.description: Checks a numeric field against rules in order; the first rule that matches sets its fields and the message leaves on above. No match leaves on below.

fields.help: Payload path, e.g. metrics.temp.
fields.label: Field

fields.help: List of {gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, set}; all given bounds must hold.

item_fields.help: Payload fields set when the rule matches.
item_fields.label: Set fields

fields.label: Rules

nodes.label: Threshold

nodes.description: Lets the message out on changed only when the field moved by more than the deadband since the last message that passed. The first message always passes.

fields.help: Payload path, e.g. value.
fields.label: Field

fields.help: Smallest change that counts. Non-numeric values pass on any change.
fields.label: Deadband

nodes.label: On change

nodes.description: Builds a new payload: each output field is set from an expression on the old one.

fields.help: Object of output field path -> expression.
fields.label: Fields

nodes.label: Transform

nodes.description: Sets one payload field to the result of an expression.
nodes.label: Expression

nodes.description: Looks a field's value up in a table and stores the match (or the default) in another field.

fields.help: Object of value -> result.
fields.label: Table

fields.help: Result when the value is not in the table.
fields.label: Default

nodes.label: Lookup

nodes.description: Runs a small Voltrus DSL program on the payload. A program that returns nothing drops the message.
nodes.label: DSL

nodes.description: Runs a saved JavaScript script with the chosen payload fields as input and merges its result into the payload. A failing script sends the message to error.

fields.help: Id of a script from Scripts.
fields.label: Script id

fields.help: List of payload fields passed to the script.
fields.label: Input fields

nodes.label: Script

nodes.description: Waits before sending the message on (at most one hour). The flow does not start another run while it waits. Test runs do not wait.
nodes.label: Delay

nodes.description: Lets at most max messages through per period. Extra messages leave on dropped, or with keep latest the newest one is held and sent on when the period allows.
nodes.label: Rate limit

nodes.description: Writes a value to a tag through the command queue, under the tag's write policy (writable, range, deadband, rate, reason). A refused write goes to error.

fields.help: Expression for the value. Empty uses the first number in the payload.
fields.label: Value

fields.help: Shown in the command log; defaults to the flow.
fields.label: Reason

nodes.label: Write tag

nodes.description: Sends a notification. Placeholders {{field.path}}, {{payload}}, {{flow_id}} and {{error}} are filled from the message. A failed delivery goes to error.

fields.help: Email addresses or webhook URLs, comma-separated (email and webhook).
fields.label: To

fields.help: Whose notification settings to use (settings channel); also shown as the source.
fields.label: Source key

nodes.label: Notify

nodes.description: POSTs the payload as JSON to a URL. A failed request goes to error.
nodes.label: HTTP request

nodes.description: Publishes a numeric payload field as a live value under the device flow_<flow id>.
nodes.label: Set flow tag

nodes.description: Records the message (or one field) in the run trace and sends it on unchanged.

fields.help: Payload path to record; empty records the whole message.
fields.label: Field

nodes.label: Debug

triggers.description: Runs only from the run button or POST /api/v1/flows/{id}/run.
triggers.label: Manual

triggers.description: Fires when one of the tags (any protocol) changes by more than the deadband. Payload: data_source_id, key, device_id, metric, value, previous, quality, ts (ms). The first value seen after start only sets the baseline.

fields.help: Smallest change that fires.
fields.label: Deadband

triggers.label: Tag change

triggers.description: Fires on every poll of a device (any protocol). Payload: device_id, status, timestamp, metrics, simulated.

fields.help: "*" for every device.
fields.label: Device

fields.help: Only fire when the poll has this metric.
fields.label: Metric

fields.help: Minimum time between runs.
fields.label: Debounce

fields.help: Skip polls where the metric (or all metrics) did not change.
fields.label: Only on change

triggers.label: Device poll

triggers.description: Fires on messages to the built-in broker on a topic filter (+ and # wildcards). A JSON body becomes the payload; other bodies become {value}.
triggers.label: MQTT message

triggers.description: Fires when an alarm is raised, cleared or acknowledged. Payload: event, alarm_id, source_key, severity, message, value, state, actor, ts.

fields.help: Only alarms of this severity.
fields.label: Severity

fields.help: Only alarms of this source.
fields.label: Source key

triggers.label: Alarm

triggers.description: Fires every interval (checked once a second). Payload: timestamp.
triggers.label: Interval

triggers.description: Fires on a cron schedule in the server's local time (minute hour day month weekday, or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly). Payload: timestamp.
triggers.label: Schedule

triggers.description: Fires on POST /api/v1/flows/{id}/webhook with the flow's token in the X-Flow-Token header (an admin creates it with POST /api/v1/flows/{id}/webhook-token). The JSON body becomes the payload. Rate-limited.
triggers.label: Webhook
